prompt: A Pufferpig (Pufferpig), a Star Wars canon creature. Pufferpigs were a non-sentient, herbivorous porcine species native to the planet Kyryll. Puffer pigs were occasionally bred for their meat, which was consumable by several sentient species and resulted in the animal being exported to numerous planets. The true value of a Puffer pig was it's ability to sniff out certain precious metals. RimWorld top-down pawn sprite, desert-world creature, painterly game-art style matching the existing RimWorld/Star Wars mod roster, clean silhouette, transparent background.
